title: I’m 17 and built a free game that tests if you can spot fake breakouts on real stock charts
author: tradelee
selftext:
Built this in 3 days using AI (Claude Code): you see a real historical chart frozen right as a breakout triggers — you get 10 seconds to call it, real or trap. Then it plays out candle by candle.

Fun stat from building it: only \~30% of breakouts in my sample actually followed through. The game trains you to spot which ones.

Free, no signup: trade-lee.vercel.app

Would love honest feedback — especially whether the drills feel realistic and what would make you come back daily.

comments.author: Scott_Malkinsons
comments.body:
Step 1 would be learn how to trade before you make games about trading. This is absolutely comical, like absurdly comical. 

All you're doing for fakeout or breakout is seeing if price is above or below some arbitrary point where people, most likely, aren't going to be looking for a breakout. And then when you select an option it just kinda goes forward a few bars and gives up; but what if I would have held longer or shorter? What if I would start at a different point? Etc.

This doesn't feel fake AF, it IS fake AF.

Here's your fundamental problem: most traders lose. Most traders talk here on Reddit and it's the blind leading the blind. AI which you're using learned from Reddit. Thus it stands to reason that asking AI anything about trading is a futile effort. You can't ask AI to bust out a trading game if you don't know how to trade because it's going to give you some absolute garbage like you got right now.

And let's be honest, I even suspect you know the game is total BS. The entire point is you're trying to advertise prop firm affiliate links. The goal isn't to simulate the market for you, it's to make it look all rosy and easy so people signup with your prop firm links.
